test7a_demo_regression.query: What did Ambedkar say about social democracy?

fts_top.title: Closing Address to the Constituent Assembly: Social Democracy
fts_top.content: In his historic closing address on 25 November 1949, Dr. Ambedkar defined social democracy: 'Political democracy cannot last unless there lies at the base of it social democracy. What does social democracy mean? It means a way of life which recognizes liberty, equality and fraternity as the principles of life.' He emphasized that these principles form an inseparable trinity: without equality, liberty produces supremacy of the few; without liberty, equality suffocates individual initiative.
